1.consolidated_definition: La marihuana es un tipo de planta cuya hoja se utiliza para producir efectos psicoactivos y recreativos, principalmente a través del consumo de su resina o por inhalación.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Cannabis is a type of plant whose leaf is used to produce psychoactive and recreational effects, primarily through the consumption of its resin or by inhalation.

reference_definitions: Voz usada por drogadictos. Planta de la marihuana.
